obligations.intent_statement: At least one input is a positive number; gcd(0, 0) is left undefined.
assumptions: every input is a safe integer (below 2^53), so a TypeScript number behaves as a mathematical integer

obligations.intent_statement: The gcd of two numbers that are not both zero is a positive number.
The remainder strictly decreases at every step, so the loop terminates.
Throughout the loop at least one operand is positive, so the remainder stays in nat.
The result is a common divisor of both inputs.
assumptions: inputs are sampled in 1..40, inside the contract precondition (at least one input positive); gcd(0, 0) stays undefined

obligations.intent_statement: A common divisor of positive inputs is never larger than either input.
assumptions: inputs are sampled in 1..40, so both are positive and the postcondition of GCD-02 (result >= 1) holds on the sample
